english.note: 狗嘅味 means the smell of a dog.

exampleSentences.english: Someone’s wearing a coat. It smells like a dog and has fur on it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 人着褸啊。帶有狗嘅味同埋毛啊喺件褸上邊啊。
